title: Bryan Johnson's simplified morning routine: light, hair care, Blueprint stack, exercise, red light, meditation
summary: Bryan walks through his streamlined morning: sleep data, light and temperature checks, hair serums and red light cap, Blueprint longevity mix and nutty pudding, daily workout, 6-minute red light therapy, a high-fiber super veggie breakfast and a time-travel meditation. He stresses lab-testing everything and keeping the routine simple, affordable and consistent.

principles.text: Map your morning into a fixed sequence of steps so it happens automatically every day.
principles.quote: the moment I get out of bed it's the same sequence of steps every day and you probably do the same in your life as well just map out those steps structure it in a way it just happens every day and you don't think about it

principles.text: Exercise is non-negotiable: do it every single day, no deciding.
principles.quote: now I'm going to work out where it's not a question if I'm going to work out I just do it every single day

principles.text: Don't trust labels; lab-test supplements and foods for contents and heavy metals.
principles.quote: we learned that basically we don't trust anyone the only thing you can trust is data

principles.text: Sleep, exercise and good eating are the foundation that keeps you calm under stress.
principles.quote: because I have my basics of Health and Wellness in place of like good sleep and exercise and eating well I just handle these things with much more calm

principles.text: Start hair care early, in your 20s, since lost hair is hard to recover.
principles.quote: in your early early to mid 20s you can start losing your hair and even if you don't see it it's it's always best to begin paying attention to Hair Care earlier rather than later

principles.text: Eat a very high-fiber diet, over 30 g a day, about 3x the average American.
principles.quote: my diet is uh has over 30 g a day of fiber so the average American I think get somewhere around 10 so I'm about 3x
